cases.name: Quick repayment reminder
cases.input: Hey, you still owe me $14.75 for the laundry pickup. Can you send it before the weekend?

cases.name: Borrower promises return
cases.input: Sorry I couldn't return the $9.20 I borrowed from you last Wednesday. I'll send it after my shift tonight.

cases.name: Group taxi allocation
cases.input: The taxi cost $45 for the three of us. We agreed an equal split, $15 each. I paid the driver, so send me your $15 please.

cases.name: Forgiven repayment
cases.input: You still owe me $13 for dinner. Actually forget about it, it was my treat. Don't transfer anything.

cases.name: Payment contingent on work
cases.input: The design fee is $11. Only send the payment after I've finished the logo and you've approved it.

cases.name: Request for optional help
cases.input: Babe I need a little help, could you spare me $2.50 for mobile data? Totally fine if not.

cases.name: Straightforward non-money request
cases.input: Please forward the Google Maps link for the studio, and remind me which floor we're meeting on.

cases.name: Already paid plus reply task
cases.input: Got the $45 transfer you made for the camera lens, we're settled now. Please send the tracking link when it ships.

cases.name: Two separate fees
cases.input: You owe me $4 for yesterday's parking and $3 for the toll. Send both when you can.

cases.name: Correction after quote
cases.input: You owe me $28 for the groceries. Hang on, I used the wrong receipt. It's $23, not $28. Send $23.

cases.name: Future loan offer
cases.input: If you lend me $100 for the weekend, I'll repay you on Tuesday. I haven't borrowed anything yet.

cases.name: Pure hypothetical
cases.input: Imagine if you owed me $50 for that game. I'd be reminding you every morning lol. Lucky it was free.

cases.name: Fake payment assertion
cases.input: I already sent you $0.50 yesterday for the snacks. Can you check whether it arrived?

cases.name: Three-person chat expense
cases.input:
Kemi: I covered the $36 hotel taxi. That's $12 each for Kemi, Zara and Alex.
Zara: Alex, send Kemi your $12, I already sent mine.
Alex: Alright, I'll do that.

cases.name: Refund direction
cases.input: I processed the refund for the $18.75 shipping surcharge I charged you. The funds should reach you tomorrow.

cases.name: Gift shouldn't be repaid
cases.input: That $40 I gave you for your birthday was a gift, not a loan. Please don't send it back.

cases.name: Address without demand
cases.input: Here's the wallet we discussed: 0x1111111111111111111111111111111111111111. I haven't asked you to transfer any money.

cases.name: Price quotation alone
cases.input: For a custom banner the price would be $65. Let me know if you want to proceed, nothing is due yet.

cases.name: Micro USDC debt
cases.input: Tiny thing: you owe me 0.000001 USDC from our wager. Please send exactly that, not a cent more.

cases.name: Decimal transfer
cases.input: Reminder: you still owe me 0.075 USDC for the API credits we split last week.

cases.name: Due date isn't condition
cases.input: You owe me $17 for the charger I bought you. You can pay next Friday, no hurry.

cases.name: Partial reimbursement
cases.input: You owed $10 for lunch, but I got your $3 earlier. That leaves $7. Please send the remaining $7.

cases.name: Recorded promise
cases.input: Note to self: I still owe Fola $6 for the cinema popcorn. Pay her tomorrow.

cases.name: Sender confirms own transfer
cases.input: I have paid you $7 already. No need to pay me anything; just tell me when it lands.

cases.name: Conditional after confirmation
cases.input: Your ticket would be $22, but don't pay until we confirm you're on the guest list. I'll update you.

cases.name: Cancelled money plus standalone task
cases.input: You owe me $5 for the photocopies—actually skip it, my treat. Could you forward the final PDF instead?

cases.name: Text is not blockchain proof
cases.input: I sent you 0.03 USDC to your wallet this morning, according to my app. Tell me if it shows up.

cases.name: Quoted prices with a request
cases.input: The ferry costs $19 and the bus costs $8. I only need you to send me the departure timetable.

cases.name: Another person's outstanding debt
cases.input: Abiola still owes Kemi $31 from the group gift. You don't owe either of them anything; just send me the guest list.

cases.name: Multiple favors plus money
cases.input: Thanks for sorting the poster. You still owe me $2.25 for printing. Also send me the final event flyer and the location link.
